abilities.label: SHIELD
abilities.text: Absorbs the first battle loss: activates once per game.

abilities.label: DOUBLE STRIKE
abilities.text: Win a battle, and the card one step beyond also takes half-damage.

abilities.label: FLANK
abilities.text: After placing this card, take one extra turn immediately.

abilities.label: OVERWHELM
abilities.text: Win a battle by 3 or more and you also win the opposing axis.

abilities.label: COMMANDER
abilities.text: All adjacent friendly cards gain +2 to every battle value when placed.

abilities.label: LASER FOCUS
abilities.text: Combines all four battle values into the North facing. Zero on all other sides.

abilities.label: RUSH
abilities.text: Can be placed next to any enemy card anywhere on the board.

abilities.label: BOOST
abilities.text: All adjacent friendly cards gain +1 to every battle value when placed.

abilities.label: FORTIFY
abilities.text: Claims all adjacent empty cells: opponents cannot place there.

abilities.label: REVENGE
abilities.text: When defeated in battle, the winning card permanently loses 1 VP.

abilities.label: HOME INVADER
abilities.text: Can be placed directly on the opponent's home row.

abilities.label: BIRTHRIGHT
abilities.text: On placement, a bonus Tier II card is added to your hand.

abilities.label: PHANTOM
abilities.text: Can be freely placed in your home row or the row above it.

abilities.label: EDGE PLAY
abilities.text: Placed on a board edge, this card wraps around to fight the card on the opposite side.

abilities.label: PIERCE
abilities.text: Edge ties count as wins for this card instead of draws.

abilities.label: AMBUSH
abilities.text: 2 random adjacent enemies each lose 1 from every battle value on placement.

abilities.label: SNIPER
abilities.text: Cancels the opposing home-row card in this column: it scores 0 VP.

abilities.label: DECIDING FACTOR
abilities.text: When a row or column ends in a tie, this card tips the result in your favor.

abilities.label: SPAWN
abilities.text: Adjacent Brood cards gain +2 to every battle value (hive sync).

abilities.label: DENSITY
abilities.text: This card contributes 1.5× its power to the row/column score.

abilities.label: LAMB
abilities.text: 5 VP but zero edges. Scores full value uncontested, nothing if attacked.

abilities.label: CLOAK
abilities.text: Edges show as ? and are revealed only when this card fights its first battle.
